# UmaLytics 0.5.2

## Fixes and improvements

- **Uma portraits:** seasonal and alternate outfits show the right art, including New Year and Anime Kitasan Black.
- **New Umas:** the newest Umas are recognized by name and portrait, including Admire Groove, Halloween Air Groove and Claret Nosferatu Duramente.
- **Draft:** alternate outfits are never mistaken for another outfit of the same Uma.

## Update

Download and extract the ZIP for your browser. Disable the previous extension, load the new build, reopen UmaLytics and refresh your drafter tabs. Confirm **v0.5.2** in the header.

The Chromium ZIP supports Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera GX. Firefox / LibreWolf uses an unsigned temporary add-on, which must be loaded again after a browser restart. SHA256SUMS.txt contains optional download integrity checksums.

Automated regression, type and build checks passed before release; they do not replace live installed-browser testing.
